reason: The executed main calls syncSendReceiveWithCheckpanic, which requires named workers, synchronous worker send (->>), worker receive (<-), and propagation of an error returned before sending into a receiver checkpanic and wait. Worker declarations and messaging behavior are not covered by subset10, despite support for start/wait and ordinary error handling. This essential unsupported behavior suffices for feature classification.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and worker-to-worker/default-worker message passing, including synchronous sends and receive error/panic propagation.
Future cancellation via f1.cancel() in retained auxiliary functions is not in the supported langlib method list.
test_design_notes: Whole file retains many unrelated worker, cancellation, query, binding-pattern and lock/start scenarios, while main exercises only syncSendReceiveWithCheckpanic.
The single @panic marker is on construction of error("err", message = "sync send err msg"); the panic is induced later by checkpanic <- w1. No @args or @output markers occur.
